missing_evidence: purchase_order (PO-1005 referenced by both INV-1005 and REC-1005 but no PO document was provided; with only one transaction in this case, there is no pattern to support treating this vendor as PO-exempt, so its absence must be flagged)
notes: Invoice, bank statement, ledger entry, and receipt all agree on vendor (GreenRoute Logistics Pvt. Ltd.), amount (59000.0 INR), and reference chain to INV-1005, giving strong internal consistency. However, PO-1005 is cited by both the invoice and the receipt but was never supplied, so its existence and terms cannot be verified - internal consistency among present documents does not establish that the PO requirement was satisfied or waived. Additionally, REC-1005 is dated 2026-07-18, three days before the invoice date (2026-07-21), an unusual sequence that raises a question about what the receipt actually evidences (e.g., goods received prior to invoicing) but does not itself indicate a missing document. The successful bank settlement (BNK-1005) confirms payment occurred but does not independently confirm that any receipt-based payment condition was met - that is established only by REC-1005 being present, which it is, though its date anomaly is noted for review.
